sourceTitle: Zenobia; or, the Fall of Palmyra
description: "Zenobia; or, the Fall of Palmyra" by William Ware is a historical novel likely written in the mid-19th century. The narrative begins with the character Piso, who shares his journey from Rome to the Eastern city of Palmyra, where he becomes embroiled in the rich culture and political intrigue surrounding Queen Zenobia.
